patch.value: Preview marked checklist hierarchy repairs before applying relations

Acceptance: reindenting one marked child proposes one native relation change; title similarity never selects a parent; cycles and deleted parents refuse before writes; compact previews include affected ancestors and children only. Overlap audit: Markdown parsing preserves indentation and imports nested rows; sessions reconcile text and cross-file ownership. Core relationship graphs, staged mutation previews, native updates and history own topology validation and persistence. This feature gives explicitly reviewed indentation native relationship meaning.
